candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 because order returns 502, which is caused by payment returning 503 on POST /v1/authorizations; the payment 5xx propagates up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as the proximate error, but no payment-side logs or metrics are admitted to confirm the internal failure mode.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s align with traces where order returns 502 and payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment path. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the bounded candidate is the propagated 5xx chain.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for POST /v1/authorizations to confirm the 503 origin
Order service logs to confirm it propagates payment 503 as 502 without its own fault
